evidence: Added entry "Test Entry QA" via Add Entry dialog; new row appeared in table, entry count went from 5 to 6.
Fields dialog shows default fields Task Name(Text), Priority(Number), Due Date(Date), Completed(Checkbox); added new field "Notes"(Text) which appeared as new column immediately.

Entered text "Test Entry QA", number 5, date 2026-12-25, checkbox toggled to Yes, and text "Sample note"; all saved and displayed correctly as "Test Entry QA", "5", "Dec 25, 2026", checked icon, "Sample note".

issue: Missing required-field validation on Add Entry
actual: Submitted the Add Entry form with the Task Name (text) and Notes fields left blank; the entry was still added successfully to the table (row shows empty Task Name, Priority 0, today's date, empty Notes) instead of being blocked with a validation message.

evidence: Priority field is a native number input; attempting to type "abc" left the value unchanged at "0" (non-numeric characters rejected).
Due Date field is a native date input; setting an invalid date "2026-02-30" resulted in the field value being cleared/rejected (empty string), while a valid date "2026-02-28" was accepted correctly.
Clicking "Cards" switched the view from table to a card grid layout showing all entries as individual cards; clicking "Table" (verified in initial snapshot) shows table layout.
All 7 entries with all field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) displayed accurately in both table view and card view.
Card view shows each field with its label (Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) plus a type-specific icon; table view shows field names as column headers with sort buttons.
Completed=No renders an X icon (lucide-x), Completed=Yes renders a Check icon (lucide-check) — visually distinct icons plus "Yes"/"No" text.
Typing "landing" into the search box immediately filtered the table to show only the "Design new landing page" entry, with status text updating to "1 entry matching \"landing\"".

Sort menu offers all fields (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes); selecting Priority sorted cards ascending (0,1,1,2,2,3,5), and clicking again toggled to descending (5,3,2,2,1,1,0). Status text confirmed "Sorted by Priority (ascending/descending)".
Clicking sort options immediately re-ordered the entries and updated the status label without noticeable delay.

After sorting by Priority ascending then descending, all 7 entries' field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) remained identical to pre-sort values; only order changed, no data modified or lost.

actual: Explored the entire UI (toolbar, column headers, Fields dialog, DOM search for "filter") and found no dedicated filter control to display only entries matching specified criteria (e.g., filter by field value/range). Only a free-text Search box (matches any field) and column-based Sort exist; there is no way to apply criteria-based filters such as "Priority > 2" or "Completed = Yes only".

issue: Filter feature absent, cannot verify accurate inclusion/exclusion
actual: Since no filter UI exists in the application (confirmed via UI inspection and DOM search), it is impossible to apply or verify criteria-based filtering. This is a dependent failure of FT-6.

evidence: Used keyboard drag (Space to pick up, ArrowDown x2, Space to drop) on "Design new landing page" row handle; entry moved from position 1 to position 3, matching the 2-step downward move performed. Status text confirmed "Draggable item entry-1 was dropped over droppable area entry-3" and table order updated accordingly.

actual: Clicking the trash/delete icon on an entry row immediately deleted the entry (count dropped from 7 to 6) with no confirmation dialog, button, or any prompt shown to prevent accidental deletion.
